records.label: spacr.image_stitch#0
records.source: Stitch the tiles of one field into one image.
records.context: Stitch the microscope image fields of one microscope field of view into one image.
records.translation: 把一个视野的图块拼成一张图像。

records.label: spacr.image_stitch#1
records.source: spaCR's filename convention -- ``plate_well_T####F###L##A##Z##C##`` -- has no tile slot, so a field split into four tiles produces four images with one canonical name and three of them would be overwritten. Three answers were possible: grow the convention a tile slot, give each tile its own field number, or put the field back together. spaCR stitches at import, with the option to turn it off: a stitched field is one image with one name, so nothing downstream has to handle tiles.
records.context: spaCR's filename convention -- ``plate_well_T####F###L##A##Z##C##`` -- has no microscope image field slot, so a field split into four microscope image fields produces four images with one canonical name and three of them would be overwritten. Three answers were possible: grow the convention a microscope image field slot, give each microscope image field its own field number, or put the field back together. spaCR stitches at import, with the option to turn it off: a stitched field is one image with one name, so nothing downstream has to handle microscope image fields.
records.translation: spaCR 的文件名约定 -- ``plate_well_T####F###L##A##Z##C##`` -- 没有图块位置，因此分成四个图块的视野会产生四张使用同一个规范名称的图像，其中三张会被覆盖。可能的办法有三种：给约定增加图块位置，给每个图块各自的视野编号，或把视野重新拼合。spaCR 在导入时拼合，并可选择关闭：拼合后的视野是一张只有一个名称的图像，因此下游无需处理图块。

records.label: spacr.image_stitch#2
records.source: A tile index is not a position. ``tile03`` says an image is the third of some number; it does not say where it goes, how the tiles are ordered, or how far they overlap. Every one of those has to come from evidence, and this module is arranged around where the evidence is:
records.context: A microscope image field index is not a position. ``tile03`` says an image is the third of some number; it does not say where it goes, how the microscope image fields are ordered, or how far they overlap. Every one of those has to come from evidence, and this module is arranged around where the evidence is:
records.translation: 图块索引不是位置。``tile03`` 只说明一张图像是若干张中的第三张；它并没有说明图像应放在哪里、图块如何排序，或相互重叠多少。这一切都必须来自证据，本模块正是按证据所在之处来组织的：

records.label: spacr.image_stitch#3
records.source: 1. The file's own stage coordinates, when it has them. An OME-TIFF records ``PositionX``/``PositionY`` in microns and the pixel size beside them, so the layout is read rather than inferred. 2. The pixels, otherwise. Adjacent tiles overlap, and the overlap is the same picture twice, so the right displacement is the one whose implied overlap correlates -- scored for every admissible displacement rather than picked from a phase-correlation peak, which a small overlap buries. This also settles the order -- row-major and serpentine put different tiles beside each other, so the arrangement that correlates is the arrangement the microscope used. 3. No evidence. Blank tiles, single-pixel overlaps and images with no shared content produce no correlation to speak of. The tiles are then butt-joined in a square-ish grid and the mosaic is marked ``assumed`` with its confidence, so the user is told the layout was not verified.
records.context: 1. The file's own stage coordinates, when it has them. An OME-TIFF records ``PositionX``/``PositionY`` in microns and the pixel size beside them, so the layout is read rather than inferred. 2. The pixels, otherwise. Adjacent microscope image fields overlap, and the overlap is the same picture twice, so the right displacement is the one whose implied overlap correlates -- scored for every admissible displacement rather than picked from a phase-correlation peak, which a small overlap buries. This also settles the order -- row-major and serpentine put different microscope image fields beside each other, so the arrangement that correlates is the arrangement the microscope used. 3. No evidence. Blank microscope image fields, single-pixel overlaps and images with no shared content produce no correlation to speak of. The microscope image fields are then butt-joined in a square-ish grid and the stitched image grid is marked ``assumed`` with its confidence, so the user is told the layout was not verified.
records.translation: 1. 文件自身的载物台坐标（如果有）。OME-TIFF 以微米记录 ``PositionX``/``PositionY``，并在旁边记录像素大小，因此布局是读出来的而不是推断的。 2. 否则使用像素。相邻图块会重叠，而重叠部分就是同一幅画面出现了两次，因此正确的位移是其隐含重叠相关的那一个 -- 对每个允许的位移打分，而不是从相位相关峰值中挑选，因为小的重叠会把峰值淹没。这也确定了顺序 -- 按行和蛇形排列会把不同的图块放在一起，所以相关的那种排列就是显微镜所用的排列。 3. 没有证据。空白图块、仅一个像素的重叠以及没有共同内容的图像不会产生值得一提的相关。这时图块以近似正方形的网格对接拼合，镶嵌图被标记为 ``assumed`` 并附上其置信度，让用户知道布局未经验证。

records.label: spacr.image_stitch#4
records.source: A mosaic assembled at the wrong overlap is a field with a duplicated band through it, every measurement in that band counted twice, and nothing on screen saying so. The confidence is therefore returned with the result, and a caller can refuse a mosaic below a chosen confidence.
records.context: A stitched image grid assembled at the wrong overlap is a field with a duplicated band through it, every measurement in that band counted twice, and nothing on application view saying so. The confidence is therefore returned with the result, and a caller can refuse a stitched image grid below a chosen confidence.
records.translation: 以错误重叠拼成的镶嵌图是一个带有重复条带的视野，该条带中的每次测量都被计两次，而屏幕上没有任何提示。因此置信度会随结果一起返回，调用者可以拒绝置信度低于所选值的镶嵌图。

records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.load_volume_image_and_mask#0
records.source: Open a grayscale spatial volume for native 3-D editing.

records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.load_volume_image_and_mask#1
records.source: TIFF volumes need exactly three spatial axes, in any order. A plain three-dimensional page stack (tifffile's ``Q`` or ``I`` page axis over ``YX``) is read as Z sections, as z-stacks and FIB-SEM series are saved; time, channel and colour axes are refused. ``voxel_spacing`` metadata is read in storage-axis order. OME physical sizes are converted to micrometres; ImageJ spacing and XY resolution are retained. MRC volumes (``.mrc``, ``.rec``, ``.map``) are read as ZYX with their voxel size in nanometres; they need the optional ``mrcfile`` package. Absent physical metadata means pixel coordinates. Labels retain dtype and identity. A saved geometry sidecar is bound to the exact source file and mask pixels and is refused when stale.
records.context: TIFF volumes need exactly three spatial axes, in any order. A plain three-dimensional page stack (tifffile's ``Q`` or ``I`` page axis over ``YX``) is read as Z sections, as z-stacks and FIB-SEM series are saved; time, image data channel and colour axes are refused. ``voxel_spacing`` metadata is read in storage-axis order. OME physical sizes are converted to micrometres; ImageJ spacing and XY resolution are retained. MRC volumes (``.mrc``, ``.rec``, ``.map``) are read as ZYX with their voxel size in nanometres; they need the optional ``mrcfile`` package. Absent physical metadata means pixel coordinates. Labels retain dtype and identity. A saved geometry sidecar is bound to the exact source file and mask pixels and is refused when stale.
records.translation: TIFF 体积恰好需要三个空间轴，顺序不限。一个普通的三维页面堆栈（tifffile 的 ``Q`` 或 ``I`` 页面轴位于 ``YX`` 之上）按 Z 截面读取，这也是 z 堆栈和 FIB-SEM 系列的保存方式；时间、通道和颜色轴会被拒绝。``voxel_spacing`` 元数据按存储轴顺序读取。OME 物理尺寸会被转换为微米；ImageJ 间距和 XY 分辨率会被保留。MRC 体积（``.mrc``、``.rec``、``.map``）按 ZYX 读取，体素大小以纳米计；它们需要可选的 ``mrcfile`` 包。缺少物理元数据意味着使用像素坐标。标签保留数据类型和标识。保存的几何附属文件与确切的源文件和掩码像素绑定，过期时会被拒绝。

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare#0
records.source: Run Compare — two runs of the same project, side by side.
records.context: Run Compare — two runs of the same project, side by side.
records.translation: Run Compare -- 同一项目的两次运行，并排比较。

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare#1
records.source: Pick a project, pick two of its runs, and the screen answers the three questions that follow a re-run:
records.context: Pick a project, pick two of its runs, and the screen answers the three questions that follow a re-run:
records.translation: 选择一个项目，再选择它的两次运行，窗口就会回答重新运行之后的三个问题：

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare#2
records.source: 1. **What did I change?** The settings diff, grouped under the same headings the settings panel groups them by, showing only what moved, so two changed keys under *Cellpose* are not lost among two hundred. 2. **What came out?** Objects, wells and fields per plate and overall. A run that produced 12% fewer cells has a problem, and this is where it is visible first. 3. **Which hits moved?** Appeared, vanished, and changed rank. A hit list whose membership is stable but whose top ten reshuffles every run is not a stable result.
records.context: 1. **What did I change?** The settings diff, grouped under the same headings the settings panel groups them by, showing only what moved, so two changed structured-data names under *Cellpose* are not lost among two hundred. 2. **What came out?** Objects, microplate sample positions and microscope fields of view per laboratory microplate and overall. A processing session that produced 12% fewer cells has a problem, and this is where it is visible first. 3. **Which hits moved?** Appeared, vanished, and changed rank. A hit list whose membership is stable but whose top ten reshuffles every processing session is not a stable result.
records.translation: 1. **我改了什么？** 设置差异，按设置面板分组所用的同样标题分组，只显示发生变化的内容，这样 *Cellpose* 下改变的两个键就不会淹没在两百个键之中。 2. **产出了什么？** 每块板及总体的对象、孔和视野。产生的细胞少了 12% 的运行是有问题的，而这里是最先能看到问题的地方。 3. **哪些命中发生了移动？** 新出现的、消失的以及排名变化的。成员稳定、但前十名在每次运行中都重新洗牌的命中列表，不是稳定的结果。

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare#3
records.source: All three come from :mod:`spacr.run_compare`, which is headless: this file picks the runs and draws the tables and knows nothing else. The run lists come from the artifact registry (:mod:`spacr.artifacts`), never from a filesystem scan — a run whose outputs were deleted still has its settings recorded, and dropping it from the dropdown would lose the only copy of what produced the numbers somebody is asking about.
records.context: All three come from :mod:`spacr.run_compare`, which is headless: this file picks the runs and draws the tables and knows nothing else. The processing session lists come from the artifact registry (:mod:`spacr.artifacts`), never from a filesystem scan — a processing session whose outputs were deleted still has its settings recorded, and dropping it from the dropdown would lose the only copy of what produced the numbers somebody is asking about.
records.translation: 这三者都来自 :mod:`spacr.run_compare`，它是无头的：本文件只挑选运行并绘制表格，别的一概不知道。运行列表来自工件注册表（:mod:`spacr.artifacts`），绝不来自文件系统扫描 -- 输出已被删除的运行仍记录着它的设置，把它从下拉列表中去掉会丢失产生那些有人在询问的数字的唯一副本。

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare#4
records.source: **Incomparable runs are not diffed.** Two runs of different plates subtract perfectly well and produce a table that looks exactly like a regression report. When :func:`spacr.run_compare.comparability` raises a blocker the tables stay empty and the banner says why, with a *Compare anyway* button that overrides the blocker. Warnings — a different spaCR version above all — are shown with the tables rather than instead of them, because a version change explains a count change on its own.
records.context: **Incomparable runs are not diffed.** Two runs of different laboratory microplates subtract perfectly well and produce a table that looks exactly like a regression report. When :func:`spacr.run_compare.comparability` raises a blocker the tables stay empty and the banner says why, with a *Compare anyway* button that overrides the blocker. Warnings — a different spaCR version above all — are shown with the tables rather than instead of them, because a version change explains a count change on its own.
records.translation: **不可比较的运行不做差异比较。** 两块不同板的运行完全可以相减，并得到一张看起来恰如回归报告的表。当 :func:`spacr.run_compare.comparability` 提出阻止项时，表格保持为空，横幅会说明原因，并带有一个 *Compare anyway* 按钮来覆盖阻止项。警告 -- 尤其是不同的 spaCR 版本 -- 会与表格一同显示而不是取代表格，因为版本变化本身就能解释计数的变化。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#0
records.source: Download ``run_file`` into ``destination``, stopping after ``max_reads``.
records.context: Download ``run_file`` into ``destination``, stopping after ``max_reads``.
records.translation: 把 ``run_file`` 下载到 ``destination``，在达到 ``max_reads`` 后停止。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#1
records.source: The stream is decompressed as it arrives and the connection is dropped the moment enough reads are in hand, so a limited request transfers only what it needs. ``max_reads`` of ``None`` fetches the whole file.
records.context: The stream is decompressed as it arrives and the connection is dropped the moment enough reads are in hand, so a limited request transfers only what it needs. ``max_reads`` of ``None`` fetches the whole file.
records.translation: 数据流在到达时即被解压，一旦拿到足够的读段就断开连接，因此受限请求只传输所需的部分。``max_reads`` 为 ``None`` 时会获取整个文件。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#2
records.source: Written back out as ``.fastq.gz`` because that is what the ``src`` setting documents for sequencing ("the folder of .fastq.gz reads"), so a subset and a full download are the same shape to everything downstream.
records.context: Written back out as ``.fastq.gz`` because that is what the ``src`` setting documents for sequencing ("the folder of .fastq.gz reads"), so a subset and a full download are the same shape to everything downstream.
records.translation: 重新写出为 ``.fastq.gz``，因为 ``src`` 设置就是这样为测序记录的（"the folder of .fastq.gz reads"），这样子集和完整下载对下游的一切都具有相同的形状。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#3
records.source: Without an ``opener``, the downloaded ``reads`` example set is read first: when it holds this file with at least ``max_reads`` reads, they are taken from it rather than from ENA, so a limited request works offline and gives the same reads. A whole-file request, or one larger than the cache, streams from ENA as before.
records.context: Without an ``opener``, the downloaded ``reads`` example set is read first: when it holds this file with at least ``max_reads`` reads, they are taken from it rather than from ENA, so a limited request works offline and gives the same reads. A whole-file request, or one larger than the cache, streams from ENA as before.
records.translation: 没有 ``opener`` 时，先读取已下载的 ``reads`` 示例集：当其中包含该文件且至少有 ``max_reads`` 个读段时，读段取自其中而不是 ENA，因此受限请求可以离线工作并给出相同的读段。对整个文件的请求，或大于缓存的请求，仍像以前一样从 ENA 流式获取。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#6
records.source: called with ``(reads_so_far, compressed_bytes_so_far)``.
records.context: called with ``(reads_so_far, compressed_bytes_so_far)``.
records.translation: 以 ``(reads_so_far, compressed_bytes_so_far)`` 调用。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#7
records.source: polled between chunks; a truthy answer abandons the download and removes the partial file.
records.context: polled between chunks; a truthy answer abandons the download and removes the partial file.
records.translation: 在数据块之间轮询；返回真值会放弃下载并删除部分文件。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#8
records.source: the path written.
records.context: the path written.
records.translation: 写入的路径。
records.review_basis: reused from an existing reviewed record of the identical source block

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#9
records.source: for a non-positive ``max_reads``.
records.context: for a non-positive ``max_reads``.
records.translation: 当 ``max_reads`` 不是正数时。

records.label: spacr.sra.fetch_reads#10
records.source: when the stream stops before the reads asked for and before the end of the file, so a dropped connection never leaves a short file that looks complete.
records.context: when the stream stops before the reads asked for and before the end of the file, so a dropped connection never leaves a short file that looks complete.
records.translation: 当数据流在请求的读段到达之前、且在文件结束之前停止时，这样中断的连接绝不会留下一个看起来完整的短文件。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.show_preferences_on#2
records.source: The tab is found by object name rather than by index or caption. An index moves whenever a tab is added, and a caption is translated -- a Korean interface would have matched nothing. Every page sets its own ``PreferencesTab*`` name, and ``tools/build_help_search_index.py`` reads those same names out of this dialog's source, so the two ends of the hand-off are the same string by construction.
records.context: The tab is found by object name rather than by index or caption. An index moves whenever a tab is added, and a caption is translated -- a Korean interface would have matched nothing. Every page sets its own ``PreferencesTab*`` name, and ``tools/build_help_search_index.py`` reads those same names out of this dialog's source, so the two ends of the hand-off are the same string by construction.
records.translation: 通过对象名称而非索引或标题来查找选项卡。每增加一个选项卡，索引就会移动，而标题会被翻译 -- 韩语界面将什么也找不到。每个页面设置自己的 ``PreferencesTab*`` 名称，``tools/build_help_search_index.py`` 从此对话框的源代码中读取同样的名称，因此交接的两端在构造上就是同一个字符串。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.show_preferences_on#3
records.source: The dialog is usually built already (:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._warm_the_preferences`), and the window redraws after the close only when something it draws from changed: the build, the first show and the unconditional redraw each held the GUI thread for longer than a frame.
records.context: The dialog is usually built already (:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._warm_the_preferences`), and the window redraws after the close only when something it draws from changed: the build, the first show and the unconditional redraw each held the main GUI execution path for longer than a frame.
records.translation: 对话框通常已经构建好（:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._warm_the_preferences`），关闭后只有当窗口所绘制的内容发生变化时才会重新绘制窗口：构建、首次显示和无条件重绘各自都会让 GUI 线程占用超过一帧的时间。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#0
records.source: The widgets that carry the application sheet, instead of me.
records.context: The widgets that carry the application sheet, instead of me.
records.translation: 代替我承载应用程序样式表的控件。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#1
records.source: WHY NOT THE WINDOW. Setting a stylesheet on a window repolishes every descendant, and a session that has opened four modules owns 8,002 widgets of which 7,595 are inside module screens -- ONE of which is on screen. Measured on this box, four modules open, alternating dark and light:
records.context: Why not the window. Setting a stylesheet on a window repolishes every descendant, and a session that has opened four modules owns 8,002 widgets of which 7,595 are inside module application views -- ONE of which is on application view. Measured on this box, four modules open, alternating dark and light:
records.translation: 为什么不是窗口。给窗口设置样式表会重新润色每一个后代，而打开了四个模块的会话拥有 8,002 个控件，其中 7,595 个位于模块界面内 -- 其中只有一个可见。在这台机器上测得，打开四个模块，在深色和浅色之间切换：

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#2
records.source: the whole window            945 ms first, ~1,479 ms steady chrome + the visible page   300 ms first,   ~310 ms steady
records.context: the whole window            945 ms first, ~1,479 ms steady chrome + the visible page   300 ms first,   ~310 ms steady
records.translation: 整个窗口            首次 945 ms，稳定时 ~1,479 ms 框架 + 可见页面   首次 300 ms，   稳定时 ~310 ms

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#3
records.source: WHAT IS IN THE LIST, and the shape is not the obvious one. The chrome is 407 widgets and only TWO of them are reachable from the central widget -- the dock, the sidebar and the status strip hang off the window itself. An implementation that walked the central widget would leave 405 unstyled and look almost right, which is why `tests/qt/test_every_widget_wears_the_current_theme.py` does exactly that on purpose and asserts it is caught.
records.context: What is in the list, and the shape is not the obvious one. The chrome is 407 widgets and only TWO of them are reachable from the central widget -- the dock, the sidebar and the status strip hang off the window itself. An implementation that walked the central widget would leave 405 unstyled and look almost right, which is why `tests/qt/test_every_widget_wears_the_current_theme.py` does exactly that on purpose and asserts it is caught.
records.translation: 列表里有什么，其形状并不显而易见。框架有 407 个控件，其中只有两个可从中央控件到达 -- 停靠面板、侧边栏和状态条挂在窗口本身上。只遍历中央控件的实现会留下 405 个没有样式，看起来几乎正确，因此 `tests/qt/test_every_widget_wears_the_current_theme.py` 故意恰好这样做，并检查它会被发现。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#4
records.source: So: every direct child of the window except the central widget, every direct child of the central widget except the stack, and the stack's CURRENT page. The pages that are not showing are marked instead, and sheeted on their own `showEvent` before they are painted.
records.context: So: every direct child of the window except the central widget, every direct child of the central widget except the stack, and the stack's CURRENT page. The pages that are not showing are marked instead, and sheeted on their own `showEvent` before they are painted.
records.translation: 所以：除中央控件外窗口的每个直接子级，除堆栈外中央控件的每个直接子级，以及堆栈的当前页面。未显示的页面就地标记，并在绘制之前于自己的 `showEvent` 中获得样式表。

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.stylesheet_roots#5
records.source: A child that is a window of its own -- a dialog parented here, such as Preferences -- is not chrome: the sheet reaches it as a window, and a hidden one that asked to wait for its show (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN`) waits.
records.context: A child that is a window of its own -- a dialog parented here, such as Preferences -- is not chrome: the sheet reaches it as a window, and a hidden one that asked to wait for its show (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN`) waits.
records.translation: 本身就是窗口的子级 -- 以此为父级的对话框，如 Preferences -- 不属于框架：样式表以窗口的身份到达它，而要求等到显示时再处理的隐藏窗口（:data:`spacr.qt.theme.SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN`）则会等待。

records.label: spacr.qt.i18n.install_dialog_translation._DialogTranslationFilter.eventFilter#0
records.source: Retranslate a dialog's tree as it is shown.
records.context: Retranslate a dialog's tree as it is shown.
records.translation: 在对话框显示时重新翻译其树。

records.label: spacr.qt.i18n.install_dialog_translation._DialogTranslationFilter.eventFilter#1
records.source: A dialog carrying :data:`TRANSLATE_ONCE_PER_LANGUAGE` is walked once per language rather than on every show: it is kept and shown again, its text does not change between shows, and the walk was the largest part of showing it again.
records.context: A dialog carrying :data:`TRANSLATE_ONCE_PER_LANGUAGE` is walked once per language rather than on every show: it is kept and shown again, its text does not change between shows, and the walk was the largest part of showing it again.
records.translation: 带有 :data:`TRANSLATE_ONCE_PER_LANGUAGE` 的对话框每种语言只遍历一次，而不是每次显示都遍历：它被保留并再次显示，其文本在两次显示之间不变，而遍历曾是再次显示的大部分开销。

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.PreferencesDialog._build_the_dialog._save#2
records.source: A Save that closes hides the dialog before the application takes the new values: restyling a window that is about to vanish was the largest part of a Save.
records.context: A Save that closes hides the dialog before the application takes the new values: restyling a window that is about to vanish was the largest part of a Save.
records.translation: 关闭型的 Save 会在应用程序采用新值之前隐藏对话框：为即将消失的窗口设置样式曾是一次 Save 的大部分开销。

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.setVisible#2
records.source: EVERY SHOW, NOT ONLY THE FIRST, walks only the window. A dialog kept for the next open (:func:`_take_the_warm_preferences`) is shown again, and the same filters walk it again; a page still waiting is given what it missed when its tab is chosen, as on the first open.
records.context: Every show, not only the first, walks only the window. A dialog kept for the next open (:func:`_take_the_warm_preferences`) is shown again, and the same filters walk it again; a page still waiting is given what it missed when its tab is chosen, as on the first open.
records.translation: 每一次显示，而不仅仅是第一次，都只遍历窗口。为下一次打开而保留的对话框（:func:`_take_the_warm_preferences`）会再次显示，同样的过滤器再次遍历它；仍在等待的页面在其选项卡被选中时获得它错过的内容，与首次打开时一样。

records.label: spacr.qt.preferences._preferences_window_class._PreferencesWindow.setVisible#3
records.source: Each show also notes the window's look (:func:`_window_signature`), so the close can tell whether the window has anything to catch up on.
records.context: Each show also notes the window's look (:func:`_window_signature`), so the close can tell whether the window has anything to catch up on.
records.translation: 每次显示还会记录窗口的外观（:func:`_window_signature`），以便关闭时能知道窗口是否有需要补上的内容。

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#0
records.source: Install ``sheet`` on every top-level window instead of on ``app``.
records.context: Install ``sheet`` on every top-level window instead of on ``app``.
records.translation: 在每个顶层窗口上安装 ``sheet``，而不是在 ``app`` 上。

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#1
records.source: WHY, WITH THE NUMBER. `QApplication.setStyleSheet` repolishes every widget the process owns, and a session that has opened a few modules owns thousands it cannot see -- `MainWindow` builds a module screen on first navigation and keeps it in the stack afterwards. Measured on this box, offscreen, four modules open, 9,045 live widgets of which 6,111 are on screens nobody is looking at:
records.context: WHY, with the number. `QApplication.setStyleSheet` repolishes every widget the process owns, and a session that has opened a few modules owns thousands it cannot see -- `MainWindow` builds a module application view on first navigation and keeps it in the stack afterwards. Measured on this box, offscreen, four modules open, 9,045 live widgets of which 6,111 are on application views nobody is looking at:
records.translation: 为什么，附数字。`QApplication.setStyleSheet` 会重新润色进程拥有的每个控件，而打开了几个模块的会话拥有成千上万个看不见的控件 -- `MainWindow` 在首次导航时构建模块界面，之后将其保留在堆栈中。在这台机器上测得，offscreen，打开四个模块，9,045 个存活控件，其中 6,111 个位于无人查看的界面上：

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#2
records.source: app.setStyleSheet            2,836 ms first, ~7,500 ms thereafter every top-level window       1,684 ms first, ~1,900 ms thereafter the visible screen alone       222 ms
records.context: app.setStyleSheet            2,836 ms first, ~7,500 ms thereafter every top-level window       1,684 ms first, ~1,900 ms thereafter the visible screen alone       222 ms
records.translation: app.setStyleSheet            首次 2,836 ms，之后 ~7,500 ms 每个顶层窗口       首次 1,684 ms，之后 ~1,900 ms 仅可见界面       222 ms

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#3
records.source: A QUARTER OF THE COST FOR THE SAME PICTURE. The floor is lower still -- 222 ms is what the visible screen costs on its own -- and reaching it means not sheeting the hidden screens either, which is a bigger change than this one.
records.context: A quarter of the cost for the same picture. The floor is lower still -- 222 ms is what the visible screen costs on its own -- and reaching it means not sheeting the hidden screens either, which is a bigger change than this one.
records.translation: 同一画面只需四分之一的开销。下限还要低得多 -- 222 ms 是仅可见界面本身的开销 -- 而要达到它，意味着也不要把样式表应用到隐藏界面，这是比本次更大的改动。

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#4
records.source: the ``QApplication`` whose windows wear the sheet, and where the sheet itself is parked so a window created later can find it. ``None`` is accepted and does nothing, so a caller running without an application does not have to check first.

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#8
records.source: A hidden window marked :data:`SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN` is left for its next ``Show``, where :class:`_SheetsEveryWindowThatAppears` sheets it before it paints: the Preferences window kept for the next open is ~750 widgets nobody can see.
records.context: A hidden window marked :data:`SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN` is left for its next ``Show``, where :class:`_SheetsEveryWindowThatAppears` sheets it before it paints: the Preferences window kept for the next open is ~750 widgets nobody can see.
records.translation: 标有 :data:`SHEETED_WHEN_SHOWN` 的隐藏窗口留待其下一次 ``Show``，届时 :class:`_SheetsEveryWindowThatAppears` 在其绘制之前为它应用样式表：为下一次打开而保留的 Preferences 窗口有 ~750 个无人能看到的控件。
